title: parianella carvalhoi
intro: Parianella carvalhoi, commonly known as the Brazilian pennyroyal, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Parianella carvalhoi include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as calming the nervous system and providing relief from respiratory issues.
